headline: Discovery incomplete — Noble is a blockchain L1, not a contract suite; chain-level governance via Authority module; on-chain addresses for NMM not discoverable via standard sources.
short_headline: Noble L1 chain with on-chain governance module

findings.text: Noble is an application-specific blockchain (originally Cosmos SDK appchain, evolved to EVM L1 on March 18, 2026); no contract addresses surfaced from block explorers applicable to standard EVM chains.
Deployed contracts documentation at https://docs.noble.xyz and https://docs.nobleassets.xyz; no canonical deployed contract address index found for on-chain multisig or governance addresses.

Audit info: Oak Security audited codebase before launch (March 2023). Audit PDF not located. Noble has undergone subsequent upgrades including Stratum release (v10.0.0-beta.1 as of April 30, 2026) with Hyperlane integration.

GitHub repositories: noble-assets/noble (main protocol, Go/Cosmos SDK), noble-assets/networks (network configs), noble-assets/swap (x/swap module). No hardhat/foundry deployment artifacts for contract addresses found.
Protocol operates as a single L1 blockchain (noble-1 mainnet, grand-1 testnet); not a multi-chain protocol in the sense of EVM deployments across different chains.
No factory contracts identified in search results. Noble issues stablecoins (USDC, USDN, USDY, EURe, USYC, FRAX, Progmat) via asset issuer modules, not enumerable pools.

Governance: Noble Maintenance Multisig (NMM) is a 5-of-7 multisig at the chain level (Cosmos Authority module), not a smart contract on external chains. Members include Noble corporate entity and core validator partners (geographic diversity across Canada, USA, Switzerland, Korea, Ukraine, Austria). No on-chain deployed multisig address discovered.

rationale.verdict: Noble is an L1 blockchain with on-chain governance via the Authority module controlled by the NMM. Unlike smart contract protocols deployed on external chains, Noble's governance is embedded in the chain consensus layer. No externally accessible contract addresses or multisig wallets deployed on standard block explorers were discovered. The protocol's control surface is the validator set and the NMM authority, which operate at the chain consensus layer rather than through smart contracts. Future assessment runs may benefit from Cosmos SDK-specific exploration tools (gRPC endpoints, chain queries) rather than EVM block explorers.

evidence.shows: Official Noble website confirming Noble as stablecoin infrastructure blockchain with USDC, USDN, USDY, EURe, USYC, FRAX, and Progmat assets.
Noble documentation portal confirming Cosmos SDK appchain for asset issuance with CometBFT consensus, IBC interoperability, and USDN native RWA.
Primary Noble protocol repository; Go implementation of Cosmos SDK appchain; latest release v11.4.0 (April 10, 2026); Apache-2.0 licensed.
Network configuration repository with mainnet (noble-1) and testnet (grand-1) directories; permissioned PoA validator set managed by Noble Maintenance Multisig.
Mainnet noble-1 genesis and validator configuration; confirms PoA consensus and NMM governance; no deployed contract addresses listed.

Noble Maintenance Multisig (NMM) described as 5-of-7 multisig including Noble corporate entity and core validator partners with geographic diversity across Switzerland, Korea, and USA; manages chain upgrades, parameter changes, and IBC connections.
x/swap Cosmos module for StableSwap AMM on Noble; part of protocol core functionality; demonstrates asset swapping capabilities.

unknowns: D2: Canonical deployed contracts document with specific chain-level module addresses not located.
D3: Oak Security audit PDF for pre-launch codebase not discoverable via standard sources; audit date and scope unconfirmed.

D7-offchain: Noble Maintenance Multisig on-chain address (if deployed as a smart contract module on noble-1 or external chain) not discoverable via web search or GitHub; Cosmos Authority module on-chain representation requires chain-specific gRPC queries or validator query endpoint.

protocol_metadata.about: Noble is an application-specific blockchain purpose-built for native asset issuance, originally developed as a Cosmos SDK appchain (launched March 2023) and evolved to an EVM Layer 1 (March 18, 2026). It facilitates issuance and cross-chain transfer of stablecoins and real-world assets, including native USDC, USDN (a Treasury-backed yield-bearing stablecoin), and USDY. The network uses Proof of Authority consensus with a permissioned validator set managed by the 5-of-7 Noble Maintenance Multisig, ensuring institutional-grade stability and compliance-friendly governance.
